name: Plücker Ray Embedding
definition: Embeds a ray defined by origin o and direction v into a 16-dimensional multivector using Plücker coordinates (v, o x v). The input tensor has shape [..., 6] and the output has shape [..., 16].
summary: Plücker Ray Embedding maps 3D rays into a 16-dimensional multivector to achieve scale, position, and focal length invariance for robust neural rendering.
